Title: How to Build a Simple Chatbot with an API in 100 Words
Desc: Learn how to quickly build a basic chatbot using an API. This guide explains the core flow of sending user input, calling an AI endpoint, and returning responses in a minimal setup.
Author: Pro Bandey
Data:
## A chatbot is just a loop between user input and an API response.

Flow:

```text
User Message
↓
Send to API
↓
AI Processes Input
↓
Return Response
↓
Display Message
```

Example (JavaScript):

```js
async function sendMessage(msg) {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.example.com/chat", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ message: msg })
  });

  const data = await res.json();
  return data.reply;
}
```

Add UI input, call function on submit, and render responses in chat window.

That’s it—you now have a working chatbot.

To improve it, add history, streaming responses, and error handling for production use.
